requirements.quote: Emit the result as a JSON array and write it to `/home/user/output/overheat_devices.json`.

check.cmd: python3 -c "import json,sys; sys.exit(0 if isinstance(json.load(open('/home/user/output/overheat_devices.json')), list) else 1)"

requirements.quote: The array must be on one physical line (no pretty-printing / no embedded newlines).
There must be no trailing spaces anywhere in the file.
The log must consist of exactly two lines, each terminated with a single newline character “\n”:
Also tidy up the host: delete the `/var/spool/willow` directory and everything inside it.
